issues.title: Lesson videos not playing for students
issues.problem_statement: Some of the customer's students said the lesson videos keep loading and never play, mostly on their phones; this is the third time the customer has raised it, and the customer hopes it gets sorted out.

items.description: Support opened the affected lesson link the customer shared on desktop Chrome, on Safari and on a phone; the video played on each, so support could not reproduce the problem from their side.
evidence: It plays on Safari and on my phone too. So I cannot reproduce the problem from my side.
I've opened it on my desktop in Chrome and the video plays fine.

items.description: Support will raise the issue with the technical team and get back to the customer; support said they could not give a timeline.
evidence: I'll raise this with our technical team and get back to you.
I can't give you a timeline right now

items.description: Customer will ask one affected student to record a short screen recording of the video loading and send it to support along with the lesson link.
evidence: Okay, I'll ask one of the students to record it and send it to you.

skip_recommendation.explanation: Complete support call with clear next steps; the issue remains unresolved.
